text:
Maria: Quick handoff for Pioneer Telemetry (acct: pioneer-telemetry). Contract signed yesterday. Customer requested Dedicated pool (6 GPU) + burst capacity. Onboarding blocked by SSO metadata + legal data-class questions. POC shows high token churn from verbose system prompts — potential cost/rate issues if we don't optimize prompts. Renewal in ~11 months; medium risk if compliance docs slip.

Sam: Thanks Maria — can you drop the contract + IdP contact here? Adding owners: Ana (support eng) for SSO, Rory (SE) for runbook & prompt guidance, Tanya (onboarding) for kickoff/enablement. I'll own CS coordination and renewal watch. We should capture early feedback (eval prompts) now.

Ana: Will pick up SSO. Need IdP metadata (metadata XML or SAML URL), ACS/AssertionConsumerService URL, and cert. Maria: who is the IdP admin?

Maria: IdP admin is carla.perez@pioneer.example.com. Uploading contract and notes: <https://redwood.internal/accounts/pioneer-telemetry|pioneer account notes>. Also flag: they asked for burst pricing estimate.

Rory: I'll draft a runbook with quick wins: prompt trimming, KV cache suggestions, and quantization profile for their model. ETA: EOD tomorrow for v0.1. Will include sample eval prompts to track quality after optimizations.

Tanya: I'll schedule the kickoff — aiming Wed 10am PT. Invite includes CS, SE, Support, Infra, and Legal. Sending calendar invite now.

Liam: I'll add a "renewal-watch" flag in the account tracker and set quarterly check-ins. Sam, please add a monthly health snapshot so execs can see trends.

Sam: Action list I captured:
1) Ana: collect IdP metadata + upload to SSO queue (owner: Ana)
2) Rory: runbook v0.1 + eval prompts (owner: Rory)
3) Tanya: kickoff + enablement sessions (owner: Tanya)
4) Maria: upload contract + IdP admin (owner: Maria)
5) Sam: create CS ticket, set renewal-watch flag, schedule monthly health updates (owner: Sam)

Maria: Docs uploaded: contract PDF and SOW at <https://redwood.internal/storage/pioneer-contract.pdf|contract>. Sent IdP admin to Ana. Also confirm: they want burst up to 2x baseline for product demos — Rory can include cost delta in runbook.

Ana: Got the metadata from carla. Quick note: certificate uses SHA-1, they need to reissue with SHA-256. I'll loop Carla and set timeline.

Rory: Draft runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pioneer-dedicated|runbook-draft>. Included prompt samples and a short token-reduction checklist. Feedback welcome.

handoff-bot: CS ticket #CS-4921 created and assigned to Sam.

Sam: Great — closing the loop here. Next sync Friday 9am PT to confirm SSO cert regen and runbook feedback. Please update CS-4921 when you complete your tasks. :thumbsup:

Maria: Will follow up with customer on cert timeline and burst approval.

Tanya: Kickoff invite sent.

Rory: Will iterate on runbook after Ana's SSO confirmation.

Checklist:
```
Onboarding checklist:
- Contract uploaded
- IdP metadata received
- Kickoff scheduled
- Runbook v0.1 drafted
- Burst cost estimate included
- Renewal flag set
```

Sam: Thanks team — capture any customer feedback in the shared drive and tag it in CS-4921.
